title: ポケットモンスター 銀

versions.note: the Japanese Silver cartridge (POKEMON_SLVAAXJ, header checksum 0x27)

sources: The harness alone, from the game's cartridge on mGBA (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written, no play outside the harness. The cartridges and snaps were studied outside it
From its sister cartridge Pocket Monsters Kin (games/gbc/CGB-AAUJ.lua): the script and table whole but for the header check. This cartridge's font is Kin's byte for byte, found offline

Played by Kin's own moves from power-on, replayed here from the states that kept them: the opening's talk to the naming, the hero's mother at home, the professor's lab and a first wild fight (another wild one than Kin's there, played with the presses advance_through made)
What the script said agreed with the rows read off 53 of 53 pictures, over 4 scenes; 9 pages said inside a press have no picture. No screen without text was among them
The rows were the script's pages, each held against its picture; the window scrolls a row up between pages, so the comparison held each screen to the rows it gained (compare's scrolls)
notes: Read by the script games/gbc/CGB-AAXJ.lua, Kin's: the message window's two rows while its frame shows, when the page waits on its arrow or has stood half a second; and a page closed before that, when it closes. Not read: who speaks but where the game writes it into the text, menus and other boxes (a fight's commands, a choice), the screens before the story. Names chosen in play come out as typed.
